notes.zh-CN:
4.3.0

• 升级 dlssg_for_sm86 0.4.0、MFG Unlocker 1.5.0、RTX Encore rc.3；支持组件与插件安装、配置保留及按游戏清理日志。
• 方案自由选择；初始第一版停止新安装，旧记录仍可恢复。
• 独立“玩家推荐方案”：按当前游戏推荐，匹配显卡型号和驱动，显示方案、补丁版本与 DLL/ASI 入口，参考点赞及玩家确认。
• 一键分享当前已安装方案，可加备注；首次需验证身份。非 Steam 游戏可选已有游戏或确认正式名称，应用他人配置前预览差异。
• 缓存优先显示、后台刷新；交互网页帮助支持离线和独立更新，更新日志直接打开云端发行页。
• GitCode 国内下载源，GitHub 回退，Gitee 保留过渡入口。
• Encore 菜单 Insert；MFG 独立模式 Backspace，插件模式使用 OptiScaler 菜单。更新管理器不会自动替换游戏补丁。
notes.en:
4.3.0

• Update dlssg_for_sm86 to 0.4.0, MFG Unlocker to 1.5.0 and RTX Encore to rc.3, with component/plugin installation, configuration preservation and game-owned log cleanup.
• Choose schemes freely. The initial first-release scheme is retired for new installations; existing records remain recoverable.
• Separate Player recommendations for the current game, matching GPU model and driver. Cards show scheme, patch version and DLL/ASI entry alongside likes and confirmations.
• Share the currently installed scheme in one submission with optional notes; identity verification is required initially. Non-Steam games can use an existing catalog entry or a confirmed official name. Preview changes before applying another player's configuration.
• Cached browsing with background refresh; interactive offline help can update independently. Changelog opens the cloud release page.
• GitCode domestic downloads, GitHub fallback and Gitee transition.
• Menus: Insert for Encore; Backspace for standalone MFG; OptiScaler menu for plugin mode. Manager updates do not automatically replace game patches.
